thread:
Maya: Quick flag — BlueCairn renewal in ~6w. Noticed a sharp drop in production calls over last week (~60% lower). Procurement mentioned a Northwatch eval. Can we triage risk?
ops-bot: alert: account=bluecairn signal=usage_drop window=7d pct=60 link=https://console.redwood/usage/bluecairn
Eli: Yikes. Renewal date? Any seat changes?
Maya: Renewal 2026-05-12. Seats same. No billing anomalies. Likely integration change or competitor spike.
Samir: Pulled metrics -> top endpoint deltas this week vs baseline:
```
POST /v1/embeddings  -72%
POST /v1/generate    -48%
POST /v1/rerank      -85%
```
Samir: Also saw requests with host headers referencing northwatch.ai in a handful of user agents. Could be parallel eval traffic.
Eli: Action suggestion: 1) 30m sync with their new ML lead (Vikram) + SE tomorrow, 2) Offer a no-cost 2-week dedicated burst for parity tests, 3) Run a replay and a short diff on latency/cost/accuracy on their sample prompts.
Maya: Agree. Set renewal_risk=HIGH until we confirm champion or migration plans. Assign owners. :warning:
Samir: I'll own the traffic replay + perf/cost diff. Need sample prompt set and 50 representative requests from them. Aim to post preliminary numbers EOD.
Eli: I'll ping Vikram and request the prompt set + test payloads. Scheduling 30m slot tomorrow 09:30 PT. Inviting SE + Maya.
Maya: If Vikram asks for contract flexibility, I'm prepared to propose a 3-month dedicated pilot at a discount. Also prepping a short one-pager comparing our typical prod configs vs public benchmarks.
Samir: Quick note on replay infra: will replay at their typical QPS with KV-cache enabled and with batching settings matching their current config. If we need model variants (quantized vs fp16) I can run both.
Eli: Vikram replied with ETA on prompts: will share by EOD. He confirmed a Northwatch POC but said it's "early exploratory."
Maya: Good. Please capture any procurement contacts Vikram names. Also share any gaps we find in our feature parity (e.g., streaming hooks, custom tool-calling).
Samir: Running an initial smoke replay now against a copy of their sample; posting results here when done. :eyes:
Eli: Noted. I'll log this under playbook=procurement-eval and tag renewal_owner=Maya in CRM.
Maya: Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If we see migration intent, we escalate to AE + Sales Eng.
Samir: First-pass numbers: latency delta +18% on average for generate at same cost tier, but embeddings cost ~12% cheaper on our infra. Will produce full table.
Eli: Solid. Share the table and I'll prep talking points for the sync.
Maya: Great. Once the synced meeting finishes, paste the recap here and I'll decide on short-term commercial options.
Samir: Will do.
